screens.name: Home — unavailable omen
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show settled and transition states with a dominant orb, touch instruction and unavailable-omen message.
findings: Make the sample question more legible and clarify when the unavailable omen will refresh.

screens.name: Home — successful omen fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows the explicitly synthetic omen beneath the hero without displacing navigation.
findings: Increase the faint example-question contrast while preserving the orb as the visual focus.

screens.name: Approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent settled and transition compositions, and supplied evidence reports automatic advancement with an immediate reduced-motion path.
findings: Verify that automatic advancement and closing remain understandable with a physical screen reader.

screens.name: Ask — normal
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows an opaque input and stable action arrangement across the settled and transition captures.
findings: Simplify the input’s rectangular outline and inset bottom rule into one clear field boundary.

screens.name: Ask — enlarged text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the full enlarged question and stacked actions, while supplied layout evidence reports passing 200% checks.
findings: Verify field scrolling and submission with a physical keyboard open at enlarged text sizes.

screens.name: Listening — voice unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows typing promoted above retry and an explicit microphone failure notice in both captures.
findings: Place the microphone explanation nearer the fallback actions so recovery does not require scanning to the screen bottom.

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows the planning explanation, expected wait, credit reassurance and Cancel with visibly opaque transition text.
findings: Verify that the loading status and cancellation result are announced on native assistive technology.

screens.name: Question 1 — choices
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows stable question and answer placement, and supplied keyboard evidence reports immediate advancement and back-navigation recovery.
findings: Verify that immediate advancement leaves enough context for a screen-reader user to recognize the chosen answer.

screens.name: Question 2 — choices
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows consistent spacing, three short choices and a custom-answer path across both captures.
findings: Validate native announcement of the new question and its step number after a choice advances the flow.

screens.name: Question 3 — choices
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the final step with the same readable option rhythm and stable transition composition.
findings: Clarify that choosing a final answer starts prediction generation if novice testing reveals surprise at immediate submission.

screens.name: Question — keyboard heading focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 visibly outlines the new question heading, and supplied evidence reports Tab subsequently reaching the first answer.
findings: Give the heading focus outline more breathing room and align its styling with the gold control focus treatment.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows retained question context, Your answer, Change and a disabled Continue in settled and transition states.
findings: Use a clearer disabled-button treatment that distinguishes inactivity without making the label unnecessarily faint.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows enlarged question, label, Change control and input fitting above the disabled action.
findings: Verify that opening a real keyboard preserves a recoverable path to the question and Change control.

screens.name: Custom answer — filled enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows a readable multiline answer and fully visible Reveal my prediction button at 200% text.
findings: Retain this readable stacked arrangement while verifying longer answers on a physical device.

screens.name: Custom answer — synthetic keyboard constraint
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows the answer and submission action in the constrained viewport, with the question and label outside the pictured view.
findings: Keep a compact question or field label visible while typing so the constrained view retains immediate context.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show consistent loading composition with a research-specific explanation, wait expectation and Cancel.
findings: Verify that the change from planning to research is announced without repeatedly interrupting assistive-technology users.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows a clear failure heading, no-charge reassurance, primary retry and question-edit recovery in both captures.
findings: Confirm that native focus lands on the error explanation before users encounter retry.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to the retry and edit recovery paths without obscuring the primary action.
findings: Verify that retry preserves the question and all answers through a real interrupted connection.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — planning
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a support route, alternative question action and explicit credit and memory reassurance.
findings: Give Find support near you stronger visual priority relative to starting another prediction.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — prediction
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show the same clear redirect structure after prediction processing, with consistent transition text.
findings: Strengthen the support action’s prominence while keeping the reassuring no-charge explanation visible.

screens.name: Reveal — collapsed explanation
screens.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show the prediction, uncertainty label, explanation disclosure, check-back date and five follow-on actions.
findings: Reduce competition among sharing, reminders, asking again, editing and reviewing by grouping the less common actions.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded explanation
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows the explanation beginning below the retained hero and headline, with substantial fixture text continuing beyond the viewport.
findings: Bring the expanded explanation higher into view and break long reasoning into scannable sections.

screens.name: Check-in — no outcome selected
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show the outcome question beside three visible choices above the check-back date and sharing action.
findings: Give the outcome choices a clearer selectable-control treatment while retaining their spacious horizontal layout.

screens.name: Check-in — Not quite saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows matching inline saved status and a checked Not quite choice, with supplied evidence reporting reload persistence.
findings: Reduce the large confirmation notice now that the persistent inline status already confirms the save.

screens.name: Check-in — Not yet saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows the checked pending choice, explicit saved status and Still waiting to unfold notice.
findings: Use a more compact transient confirmation so pending status does not compete with the reading.

screens.name: Check-in — Yes saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows a checked Yes choice and Saved · Came true status, backed by reported storage verification.
findings: Keep the persistent selected state and reduce the duplicate bottom confirmation’s footprint.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a concise empty-state explanation and Ask the Ball action with stable transition placement.
findings: Give Ask the Ball a slightly stronger action affordance within the otherwise sparse empty state.

screens.name: History — populated
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a date rail, original question, prediction and check-back date, with supplied evidence reporting history persistence.
findings: Use a human-readable check-back date to match the conversational presentation.

screens.name: History — dense list
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows repeated rows with a partially visible third entry approaching the fixed navigation.
findings: Verify that the final row and its actions can scroll completely clear of the raised Ask orb and tab bar.

screens.name: History — persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 visibly replaces the first row’s check-back information with a checked Came true status after the reported save flow.
findings: Verify equally clear persisted History presentation for Not quite and Not yet, which are not pictured here.

screens.name: Sky — offline sample and selected question
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows disclosed offline samples, Retry, a checked Love selection and a fully visible Ask this too action.
findings: Verify sufficiently large star hit areas and a predictable screen-reader order through the spatial constellation.

screens.name: Circles — offline empty state
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows offline disclosure, Retry, disabled creation and a dimmed sharing preference with an age-related explanation.
findings: State locally whether the sharing preference is unavailable because of connectivity, age eligibility or both.

screens.name: Plans — normal
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show a checked annual option, comparable monthly pricing, explicit simulation labels and reading packs without an ornamental hero.
findings: Verify real purchase cancellation, restoration and billing announcements before treating this simulated flow as production-ready.

screens.name: Plans — enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows stacked pricing and a visible multiline continuation button at enlarged text size.
findings: Verify that enlarged-text users can discover and reach reading packs and purchase terms below the pictured viewport.

screens.name: Share
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows a small story preview and three export routes, while supplied evidence confirms PNG export but leaves OS delivery unverified.
findings: Explain the private-link audience and availability more plainly before users choose that sharing route.

screens.name: Story preview and export
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows a readable full story card and export action, with supplied evidence reporting a real PNG export and injected-error recovery.
findings: Verify physical-device export completion and return from the OS share interface.

screens.name: You — empty memory and normal settings
screens.evidence: Sheets 14, 16 and 17 show consistent account, memory and settings sections, with supplied evidence reporting preference persistence.
findings: Consolidate See plans and View plans and credits if they lead to the same destination.

screens.name: You — populated memory
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows labeled facts from the reported actual Ollama flow, with supplied runtime evidence covering edit, forget and Undo.
findings: Verify that each repeated Edit and Forget control announces its associated fact on native screen readers.

screens.name: Settings — enlarged controls
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows enlarged setting labels and an enabled large-text switch while the bottom navigation labels remain small.
findings: Provide an enlarged-text navigation treatment so essential tab labels benefit from the accessibility setting too.

screens.name: Settings — keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows a full-row gold focus outline, supported by reported 342×52 targets and Space, Enter and label activation.
findings: Verify native switch role, state announcement and focus visibility with physical assistive technology.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The sheets establish a consistent illustrated focal point, and supplied browser evidence reports stable rendering and actual animation shutdown under reduced motion.
findings: Validate the interactive Home orb’s accessible name and decorative treatment elsewhere on native screen readers.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Main-screen captures show labeled tabs, an underlined active destination and a raised central Ask orb, including small labels in enlarged settings.
findings: Increase label legibility under enlarged text and verify that the raised orb never obscures reachable content.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently separate the title from the reading balance, and captures show both one and zero readings remaining.
findings: Label the unit explicitly as readings where space permits so 1 left today is understandable without prior context.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream buttons provide consistent emphasis and accommodate multiline enlarged labels, with supplied runtime evidence covering several completed actions.
findings: Make disabled labels easier to discern while preserving a clear distinction from enabled actions.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text actions recur consistently, but the reveal screen presents several similarly weighted follow-on choices.
findings: Group less frequent reveal actions and verify generous hit areas around every text-only control.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Question screens use generously spaced divided rows, supported by reported Space and Enter advancement, focus transfer and Back restoration.
findings: Verify that native announcements make both the selected answer and immediate question change understandable.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Ask and custom-answer captures show readable serif entry text, persistent labels and a gold outline with an additional inset bottom line.
findings: Remove the redundant bottom rule and retain a single unmistakable input boundary.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged forms preserve multiline answers and submission, but the synthetic keyboard-constrained capture does not visibly retain its question or label.
findings: Keep compact question context visible and validate the layout against a physical software keyboard.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Settings captures show distinct thumb positions and a row focus outline, with reported wide activation targets and persistent keyboard-operable state.
findings: Verify switch names and on/off announcements using VoiceOver and TalkBack.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show both a clearly labeled successful fixture and a plainly stated unavailable state.
findings: Make the unavailable state’s refresh expectation more precise without suggesting a successful omen was delivered.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 15 shows labeled stars, a checkmarked selection, matching question content and a fully visible primary action.
findings: Verify large star targets and expose the spatial choices in a logical assistive-technology order.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 discloses offline status and disables creation while also showing a dimmed age-conditioned sharing switch.
findings: Associate each disabled control with its specific unavailability reason.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheet 07 distinguishes date, question, forecast and saved outcome through consistent type and spacing.
findings: Use conversational date formatting and verify a clear accessible label for opening each reading.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show checked annual selection, billing cadence, savings and readable stacked enlarged pricing within an explicit simulation.
findings: Verify selectable-group semantics and real billing recovery before certifying purchase accessibility.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show consistent thumbnail and expanded story designs, with small disclaimers in the thumbnail and reported real PNG export.
findings: Provide a readable text equivalent for the preview and verify disclaimer legibility at typical recipient viewing sizes.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Voice and saved-outcome captures show explicit messages and Dismiss controls, with supplied evidence reporting inline live status and recovery checks.
findings: Shrink duplicate success notices and place actionable error explanations closer to their recovery controls.

components.name: Typography
components.evidence: Serif headings, sans-serif utilities and selective script establish consistent roles, but navigation and several supporting labels remain small.
findings: Improve the smallest utility text and extend enlargement to essential navigation labels.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: The supplied captures maintain dark mist behind opaque text, with reported sampled contrast passes and cessation of canvas and CSS animation under reduced motion.
findings: Verify contrast and motion behavior on physical devices before extending the sampled browser result to native rendering.

limitations: All grades are provisional and assess only the supplied screenshots and runtime account; no files, previous ratings, source or external task state were inspected.

For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1), excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.
No item reaches the authorized A >=9 and F >=9 threshold; this packet does not qualify for acceptance or 9/10 certification.
Missing verification lowers confidence rather than becoming N/A: null is used only for dimensions without a meaningful role in a decorative or foundational component.
Reported browser checks support the scored interaction evidence, but screenshots alone do not establish target dimensions, semantics, persistence, successful exports or recovery.
Transition pairs show coherent sampled compositions and opaque text; they cannot establish continuity across every frame, and the reported contrast sampling covers only four screens.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, real keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver, TalkBack, microphone hardware, haptics and OS sharing remain unverified.
The synthetic keyboard-constrained capture proves visible submission in that pictured viewport, not physical keyboard behavior or continuous question visibility.
Social backend operation, authentication and real purchases are unverified; disclosed offline and simulated states are not treated as disguised success.
Fixtures establish layout coverage only, and the actual Ollama flow does not establish predictive accuracy or representative semantic quality.
No hard-gate failure is established by this packet; clipped viewport content is not assumed unreachable, and untested boundaries are not assumed to pass.
topFixes: Verify physical keyboard, native text enlargement and screen-reader flows; these remain the largest barriers to certification.
Keep compact question context visible in keyboard-constrained custom entry and enlarge essential tab labels.
Simplify input borders and reduce duplicate bottom notices to preserve the borderless visual direction.
Reduce reveal-action competition and bring expanded reasoning higher into view.
Clarify disabled Circle controls and private-link availability, and prioritize the support route on sensitive redirects.
